trail_id: REQUIRED trail id, every trail should be have a unique id in game
use_existing_trail: optional boolean, true for this trail is a existing trail data in previous rows, default false
diffuse_path: required/optional(decided by emissive) texture, aka basecolor
emissive_path: required/optional(decided by diffuse), for glow or bloom
is_tangent_angle_map: optional boolean, for has tangent map, default true
fade_in: optional float, in second, and duration(fade in + full + fade out) cannot be lower than 0.1, default 0.1
smooth_ends: optional float, controls the ratio for the transparent fade‑out at both ends of a trail, the range is [0.0, 1.0], disabled when 0.0, default 1.0
velocity_in_range: optional vec4f, based on forward directio, [minX, minY, maxX, maxY]
velocity_out_range: optional vec4f, based on forward directio, [minX, minY, maxX, maxY]
angular_in_range: optional vec2f, based on forward directio, in angle, [min, max]
angular_out_range: optional vec2f, based on forward directio, in angle, [min, max]
spawn_offset_range: optional vec4f, based on forward direction, [minX, minY, maxX, maxY]
init_capacity: optional int16_t(short), how many trails have in a typical scene, for example: 2048 for the weapon [vulkan]. default 1024
